description: Apply and format bullets and numbering on the paragraphs of the chosen text (Type > Bulleted & Numbered Lists; Bullets and Numbering dialog): list type, list and level, bullet character and font, number expression and format, text after, character style, start/continue, restart after levels, alignment, indents and tab position; or restart numbering, continue numbering, or convert bullets and numbers to text

action.description: set the options below; restart numbering at the first chosen paragraph (at startAt, default 1); continue numbering from the previous list; or convert the bullets and numbers to ordinary text

bullet.description: Bullet character: { unicode ("2022") or glyphId, fontName ("Family\tStyle" or family; needed with glyphId) }

characterStyle.description: Character style for the bullet or number

firstLineIndent.description: First line indent in mm (negative for a hanging bullet)

list.description: Name of a list (Define Lists) the paragraphs belong to, so numbering runs across frames or stories

listType.description: Bulleted list, numbered list, or no list

mode.description: Continue from the previous number, or start at startAt

numberAlignment.description: Bullet or number position: its alignment in its space

numberExpression.description: Number pattern with placeholders: ^# this level, ^1-^9 the number at that level, ^H chapter number, ^t tab; e.g. "^1.^#.^t"

restartAfter.description: Restart numbers at this level: { enabled (false turns it off), policy (ANY_PREVIOUS_LEVEL, AFTER_SPECIFIC_LEVEL, RANGE_OF_LEVELS), lowerLevel, upperLevel }

startAt.description: Starting number (with mode start_at or action restart)

tabPosition.description: Tab position in mm after the bullet or number

text.description: Which text to act on. Give text frame ids, story ids, or selection: true; optionally narrow each to a character range (start/end) or a paragraph range (paragraphs)

end.description: Last character, inclusive (default: the end of the text)

ids.description: Text frame ids (PageItem.id); acts on the text in each frame, or its whole story with wholeStory

paragraphs.description: [first, last] paragraph indexes (0-based, inclusive) within each chosen text

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

start.description: First character (0-based, within each chosen text)

wholeStory.description: For frames and selected text, act on the whole story they belong to

textAfter.description: Text after the bullet (metacharacters such as ^t for a tab)

name: set_bullets_and_numbering
title: Set Bullets And Numbering
